history.action: PowerShell Build System Audit & 32-bit PE Inspection
history.details: Audited PowerShell build script chain Build.ps1. Identified that 64-bit MinGW g++ compiler fallback generated 64-bit PE binaries (0x8664) inside BuildOutputx86/ when dedicated 32-bit cross-compiler was absent. Gate verdict: REJECT until dynamic 32-bit compiler fallback chain is added.

Updated Scripts/01_PrepareEnvironment.ps1 and Scripts/04_CompileBinaries.ps1 to implement multi-tier 32-bit compiler cascade (i686-w64-mingw32-g++, g++ -m32, MSVC cl.exe x86, or VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat x86). Built authentic 32-bit PE 0x014C binary in BuildOutputx86/FileSplitter.exe and 64-bit PE 0x8664 binary in BuildOutput/FileSplitter.exe. Built master Build.ps1 orchestrator, .gitignore, Git repo v1.2.0.0 commit, README.md, and Agent-Thread_HTML dashboard.
